MERVE 2026-11-26: somebody who SUPERVISES doctoral students is not one. WHY A PATTERN HERE AND OVERRIDES FOR THE BARE DEGREES. These titles share ROLE words - supervisor, coordinator, advisor, examiner - which a pattern matches by meaning. The bare-qualification class next door shares only SPELLING, in hundreds of unpredictable variants, and a pattern there deletes real students.
